entries.topicDescription: Unit testing, instrumented testing, and Compose UI testing on Android.

tips.title: Turbine simplifies testing Flow emissions without manual collector boilerplate
tips.content:
Testing a Flow by manually launching a collector coroutine, appending
emissions to a list, then asserting on that list after the fact is
verbose and easy to get subtly wrong around coroutine timing and test
dispatcher scheduling.

Turbine's test {} extension on a Flow gives you awaitItem(), awaitError(),
and awaitComplete() functions that suspend until the next relevant event
arrives, reading like a sequential assertion of exactly what the Flow
should emit and when — purpose-built for testing Flow-based code
correctly.
